## Design note

The tuner's R34: GT-R looks from the back seat of a narrower, lighter, rear-drive car. The turbo six pulls hard from 3000 rpm and the viscous LSD lets it hang the tail out on corner exit, but 280-ish horsepower on 225 tyres means wheelspin in first and second. Unrestricted it tops out near 245 km/h.

## How this car breaks

Same 90s HSS shell as the 25GT, plus a front-mount intercooler right behind the bumper slot: it is the first casualty of a nose hit and the car limps on low boost afterwards. Steel bonnet and wings, plastic bumpers, two long doors.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

| pitch | 2791 | 0.88 | 2460 |

## Engine

RB25DET NEO 2.5 L DOHC 24-valve I6, single ceramic-wheel turbo, intercooled, two-stage boost (≈0.5 bar to 4500 rpm, ≈0.7 bar above). Rated 206 kW (280 PS) @ 6400 rpm, 343 N·m @ 3200 [S5]; real-world factor ×1.05 (≈216 kW). The RB25DET NEO was close to its 280 PS rating; stock cars read ≈150-165 rwkW on Australian hub dynos [S15] (≈200-215 kW at the crank), so it gets a smaller factor than the RB26DETT. Curve shape [E], fitted to the rated points.

## Drivetrain

FS5R30A 5-speed manual, R200 rear viscous LSD (modelled as a mild clutch LSD). Layout **RWD**; front diff: open; rear diff: clutch LSD, preload 50 N·m, power ramp 0.35, coast ramp 0.20. Clutch capacity 1.40 × peak torque = 500 N·m. Shift time 0.43 s.

| 5 | 0.75 | 3.09 | 263 |

Final drive 4.11, reverse 3.37. Speeds use the driven-wheel loaded radius 0.308 m.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.30 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 382 kg | 1.55 Hz | 36300 N/m | 2230 N·s/m | 3340 N·s/m | 0.15 m |
| Rear | 309 kg | 1.70 Hz | 35200 N/m | 1980 N·s/m | 2970 N·s/m | 0.16 m |

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 2.6°/g with 57% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.372 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 118280 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 39729 F / 38082 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **12600 F / 5900 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 2.6°/g, front share 57%. Bump stops 160000 N/m.

Alignment: camber -0.8° F / -1.2° R, toe +0.00° F / +0.15° R (+ = in), caster 5.5°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 100 bar.

- Front: 296 mm disc, pistons per side 40 mm + 40 mm → A = 25.1 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 123 mm, pad μ = 0.4: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.4·100 bar·25.1 cm²·0.123 m = **2473 N·m**
- Rear: 297 mm disc, pistons per side 38 mm → A = 11.3 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 124 mm, pad μ = 0.4: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.4·100 bar·11.3 cm²·0.123 m = **1121 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 1612 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.53×), rear needs 607 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.84×).

`wp_vehicle` gives the axle `bias_front` favours its full `max_torque_*` and scales the other by (1 − b)/b, so `max_torque_*` holds the caliper capacity per wheel and `bias_front` acts as the proportioning valve: the rear is trimmed to the same lock margin as the front (ideal rear = T_f · lock_r/lock_f = 931 N·m), never boosted above its caliper capacity. Rear capacity exceeds that, so `bias_front` = T_r/(T_r + ideal) = **0.546** → delivered 2470 N·m front / 931 N·m rear per wheel at full pedal. Handbrake 1500 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 15.0:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 11.0 m → outer-front path radius 5.39 m, rear-axle-centre radius 3.94 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.594 rad (34.1°)** (outer 29.6°, inner 39.8° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.60). Rack speed 1.4 rad/s.
